source: ABK Group download area, "Download all (.zip)" on the colour page after sign-in, downloaded for J on 2026-10-09: GIOIA - CIELO - minimali.zip (308492 bytes, sha256 f4011a9db93299d08ddf9ded4be17158e2f23f15fa59b2b19843ddf13f997855).
note: This download holds one copy of each face. Every site picture was matched to its ZIP file by sha256 (each picture's own download, read in the signed-in browser pane). Pictures that ABK lists twice with identical bytes are used once. Face numbers run 01..n in the site's order. Landscape pictures are turned upright (90 degrees counter-clockwise). Untagged JPGs are read as sRGB.

resolution.why: Chosen by J on 2026-10-04 for Gardenia (see the Anima manifests) to keep the repository small. The app draws floors at 0.26 px per mm and walls at 0.56, so 0.6 loses nothing visible today.
resolution.sharper_masters: The original JPGs are sharper (see source_px_per_mm per face). They are kept outside the repository: J's ~/Developer/material-masters/gardenia/gioia/ holds the tracking files, and the ZIPs can be downloaded again from the source page with a Gardenia&Ariana account.
resolution.to_go_sharper: Re-export the faces from the masters at a higher px per mm with the same file names; no catalogue change is needed. See docs/architecture/surface-material-tile-faces.md.
